scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run setup:install && npm run setup:db
scripts.setup:install: npm install --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.hostinger:install: npm ci --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm ci --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps
